column3: Kuroneko Route · Kuroneko's Assistant
Good grief, you're a lost cause.
Eh? W-Why!?
You thought of ways to persuade someone, but this is your real goal?
I've been belittled.
...Huh?
There's no way I would allow a person like you to suddenly meet my sisters.
I just asked a simple question, whether your sisters are around or not?
That seems to be the case on the surface, however...
...Hey, why are you being so cautious?
Isn't that to be expected?
From your speech earlier, you have already given yourself away rather clearly.
What have I given away?
...You are a true siscon.
I'm not! A person with a real sister, there's a 100% chance of them not being a siscon!
Oh my? That means you only exclude your very own sister?
Not that. All sister-related characters are excluded.
You do know that you're not being persuasive at all by using game characters as an example, do you?
...You're hopeless if you really mean that.
I'm half-joking.
Not all of it?!
Half of it is serious.
...Do I really look like a siscon?
Yes, you do.
That's why I do not wish to let you meet my sisters.
So that means...
...Are your sisters really that cute?
...I despise you.
I'm terribly sorry.
As the elder sister, I'm obliged to take care of my sisters. That's why I allowed my sisters to go out.
Is that so... They properly call you 'onee-chan', right?
Of course.
So how could I allow a pervert like you to get close to my little sisters?
Don't take me for some dangerous person.
Aren't we chatting pretty nicely right now though?
...I'm sorry about that. But this can't be helped.
What can't be helped?
You are confirmed to be a dangerous person. Proof of this already surfaced. Please give up.
Guh...
...However.
...So I'm being treated as a pervert.
Yes, unfortunately.
...Am I really that untrustworthy?
If it's related to this matter, you're not trustworthy at all.
To begin with, did you really come here just to see my sisters? How about the original purpose?
Ah! But... yes. I'm here to help...
It's good that you know. Look, it's time we start working.
Ah... That, that's right...
Hmph... Good boy. Forget about my little sisters. Got it?
Furthermore, that isn't the objective today, is it?
...Indeed it isn't.
Don't lose sight of it again.
Guh... Yes. I'm terribly sorry.
H-Hmph... You look dejected after I said nobody was at home.
...Don't you wish to be alone with me, just the two of us?
N-Nothing of that sort.
...I-Is that so. That's good.
